en: Black-and-white view of a forest spa or resort town in a mountainous area. Several ornate late-19th/early-20th‑century villas with steep roofs and decorative facades line a gently curving road bordered by evenly spaced trees. In the foreground is a landscaped park with winding gravel paths, young trees, flowerbeds, and a small hexagonal pavilion or gazebo. Dense conifer forest rises directly behind the houses and covers the surrounding hills, which fade into the mist in the distance. One villa bears a sign with a name on its facade.
